title: 60쪽 · 3.5x EP1 Open (8%)
paragraphs: Did you notice how Snowie isn’t fist-pumping to open 10-10 from EP1? Here’s the bottom line: The blinds are your only financial incentive to open preflop. In other words, if the blinds didn’t exist you would have no incentive to play a hand from EP1. You would have incentive to move all-in with A-A from other positions if someone put chips in the pot. But other than that, you would have no incentive to play a hand.

Q-handed NL isn't much better than this scenario. $2-$5NL emer are starting with $7 in the pot and raking $7! Somehow people wonder why there’s no action. You heard it hear first folks, NL is a nitty game without antes. You're simply relying on fish to flat too much.
